description: Cancel a credential-owned Inventory Mission Control plan. Live and expired drafts may be cancelled; committed, superseded and already-cancelled plans cannot. The preview shows the plan's revision and line counts; the commit refuses if the plan was repriced since. This sets the plan status to cancelled and does not delete any data or touch drafts a plan already created. Requires Write + replenishment.prepare.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: cancel_replenishment_plan
title: Cancel Replenishment Plan
